data.body: The ddflow lanes state table shows ITEM/STATE/HEARTBEAT/FOR but not WHICH pipeline step a lane is on: for a working lane an operator cannot see whether it is on research or unit_tests without reading its brief. The Lane model already carries mid_gate (a gate.started with no later outcome) and last_event_kind for a stopped lane; extend it to a per-lane current step (the in-flight or next unsatisfied gate of the held item, else the last event kind) and render it as a STEP column in ddflow lanes (state), carried in the lane as_dict wire for CLI and MCP parity. ETA stays the ETA-surfaces tasks concern (P-eta). Tests first.
data.title: ddflow lanes state: a STEP column naming the gate each lane is on
